值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解市售熱門滾輪磨刀器的真實效果與不同角度的操作細節。
  • 見證一把鈍菜刀如何透過多階段目數磨刀石逐步蛻變至極致鋒利。
  • 透過專業銳度測試儀與全新美工刀的具體數據對比，科學化驗證打磨成果。

摘要

開箱實測與初始鋒利度檢測

作者為了驗證網紅磨刀工具的實用性，花費479元人民幣購入了一款滾輪磨刀器，並搭配專業的鋒利度測試儀進行實測。在打磨前，作者先拿出一把鈍化的中式菜刀進行測試，該刀具完全無法劃開紙張，儀器測得的阻力數值高達424克，屬於極度鈍態。該磨刀器附帶15、18、20與25度的磁吸角度導軌，滾輪內建軸承，並配備360、600、1000與3000四種目數磨刀石。

低目數粗磨階段的摸索與波折

作者首先使用360目磨刀石進行粗磨，但過程中發現刀刃出現凹坑並殘留金屬毛刺，手感甚至越磨越粗糙。因深層缺口難以磨平，作者轉而專注於刃口前段以利對比。隨後切換至600目磨刀石打磨，毛刺雖有所減少，但測得數值僅進步至294克，整體依然偏鈍，讓作者意識到必須依賴更高目數的研磨才能展現效果。

高目數精磨帶來極致鋒利逆襲

當作者換上1000目磨刀石時，研磨阻力明顯降低並帶出大量金屬粉末，原先的毛刺完全消失，鋒利度大幅躍升至124克。最後換上3000目磨刀石進行拋光，刀刃呈現鏡面反光，最終測得極致的36克鋒利度。此數值甚至超越了全新的美工刀片，在最後的切紙測試中毫不費力地滑順切過，證明了該磨刀工具的強大修復力。

================================================

Wow. >> Yours is really something. >> We managed to get that super impressive edge sharpness tester they use in their videos, and a quick test shows it's exactly 350. Wow. I specifically added him on WeChat and spent 479 RMB to buy a sharpener.

Before unboxing, let's look at its performance—we'll test a dull Chinese kitchen knife and try to perform a paper-cutting test. It’s not working at all. Let's use the sharpness tester to see how sharp it really is. 424 grams. Very...so, what do we say now? >> Friction. >> I know this! I know this; this is its sleeve. The angle guide—the edges have set angles to the table: 15, 20, 18, and 25 degrees. The whetstone side has bearings inside.

It’s so smooth; you just hold it and rotate it like this to sharpen. The stones on the sharpener have different grit levels. The lower the grit, the coarser the stone. This one is 360 grit, this is 600 grit, and it also comes with 1,000 and 3,000 grit stones. Let’s start with the 360. Attach the knife to the angle guide . Now, let's switch to—wow. >> Disinfect it first. Disinfect it, or you’ll just—.

>> Use a tissue. Damn, how did it just...Huh? 360 grit, why does it look a bit pitted ? There are even metal burrs left on it . It feels like it’s getting rougher the more I sharpen. We tried to sharpen these dents earlier but couldn't get them out, so we'll stop trying and focus on the front part; that’ll be more useful for comparison. Switched to 600 grit. After sharpening, there are still some burrs, but it's better than the 360.

. Let's check the sharpness: 294. Still pretty dull. What’s going on? Do we need higher grit to see a difference? Wow, at 1,000 grit, the friction feels much lower. Holy cow, there's so much metal dust coming off. It’s clear now; those burrs are all gone . 124 grams! Switching to 1,000 grit made a difference immediately. Now I'm looking forward to 3,000. The edge is reflecting light now.

You can't see any rough spots at all. 36. Let's try it again. You might not have a concept of what 36 sharpness means, so let's take a brand-new utility blade. It’s not even as sharp as this kitchen knife. Finally, the paper-cutting test. Ah, it still glides through so smoothly !

=============

item.title: 2026版的脆不脆？原來這才是脆不脆的祖師爺！這下真的脆了... - 陶州甘蔗
item.itunes:title: 2026版的脆不脆？原來這才是脆不脆的祖師爺！這下真的脆了... - 陶州甘蔗
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Fq75XGfoqI

值得閱讀的理由

  • 透過實際剝食，檢驗桃山青甘蔗是否真如宣傳般容易入口。
  • 作者拿它與先前吃過的雲南甘蔗、黑甘蔗和黃甘蔗比較，呈現口感差異。
  • 影片既有試吃的趣味，也坦白說明甘蔗並非每一段都好剝，感受相當真實。

摘要

作者介紹一年僅能吃到一次的桃山青甘蔗。宣傳說它皮薄、可以徒手剝開，纖維少，吃起來清脆香甜。這讓作者想起先前買過的雲南甘蔗，當時對方也說甘蔗很脆，結果硬得像棒球棒，於是作者對這次的說法半信半疑。

作者以人民幣33元買下2.5公斤甘蔗，開始嘗試徒手剝皮。部分甘蔗確實能剝開，但並非每一段都輕鬆，有些地方需要使上不少力氣；作者也笑說，實際剝起來遠沒有廣告中的示範那麼容易。

試吃後，作者覺得桃山青甘蔗清脆香甜，口感也比之前吃過的黑甘蔗或黃甘蔗稍脆。只是整體滋味並沒有明顯勝過一般甘蔗，雖然有些甘蔗段徒手就能折斷，作者仍認為它的特色主要在於口感，而非風味上的巨大差異。

================================================

Their skin is extra thin, you can just peel them by hand to eat, plus they have very little fiber, making them crunchy and sweet. >> The last person who told us sugarcane was crunchy was when we bought that Yunnan sugarcane over a year ago. >> Right? No, wait, was that right? >> It turned out to be as hard as a baseball bat. Did that woman have superpowers or something? >> This isn't bamboo, this is the Taoshan green sugarcane that you can only eat once a year. >> Let’s give it a try. 2.5 kilograms for 33 RMB. >> You can peel it by hand to eat, >> Let’s take a look at this one. Whoa, holy cow. It actually works. Wow, it’s.

not every single one, it hurts! It definitely wasn’t as easy as that woman in the ad made it look. Look how much force I’m using. Damn, judging by the sound, this isn't something you can just handle lightly. >> Look at mine, >> What’s wrong with yours? >> Ah. >> Some are easy to peel, some aren't. >> It’s crunchy and sweet. >> It is a bit crunchier than the black sugarcane or the golden sugarcane we had last time. If a section of this cane were this long, I could snap it with my bare hands, but overall the taste isn't significantly better than regular sugarcane.

=============

  • 作者以 1,600 牛頓的力量測試塑膠結構，過程既荒謬又令人好奇。
  • 比較多種啤酒瓶與一般開瓶器，直觀揭露設計不合與耐用度問題。

摘要

重測塑膠開瓶器

作者提到，上次的迫擊炮測試徹底失敗，這回則要測試一款據稱能讓瓶蓋飛起來的開瓶器。這件工具明顯是3D 列印的，連樞軸連桿都是塑膠製成；作者因此好奇，它能否承受1,600 牛頓的力量，並聯想到先前幾輛車的煞車支架接連斷裂，究竟是產品缺陷還是偶發事件。

五種瓶口，開瓶器屢屢失手

作者準備了五瓶瓶口尺寸不同的啤酒，先用瓶口大小合適的酒瓶測試，讓塑膠開瓶器卡在瓶緣，再施加 1,600 牛頓的煞車力。然而瓶蓋完全沒有飛起來，作者只好反覆撬動才將瓶蓋取下。

接著測試哈爾濱啤酒與百威，開瓶器不是碰不到瓶蓋，就是無法勾住邊緣；作者用手扶住工具、避免它壓得太低，才勉強讓它卡上瓶蓋。連續開了三瓶後，塑膠部件已磨損得相當嚴重，作者抱怨它實在不耐用。

瓶型不合，只能換回普通開瓶器

測試第四瓶烏蘇啤酒時，開瓶器仍然碰不到瓶蓋；到了嘉士伯酒瓶，瓶身甚至無法放進開瓶器。作者最後改用一般開瓶器處理嘉士伯，認為這樣反而容易得多，並對 3D 列印款的做工與實用性大失所望。

================================================

It's 3 o'clock, time to drink, grab a beer and let's go. Alright, let's try again; our last mortar test was a total failure. This one is also supposed to make the bottle cap fly off. How come it's another 3 D-printed model? It's clearly 3 D-printed. Even its pivot linkage is made of plastic. I wonder if 1,600 Newtons of force will snap it. Several cars in a row had their brake brackets suddenly break. Is it a product defect.

or just a random incident? >> We've prepared five beers with different bottle-mouth sizes. This small one fits just right. Look, the plastic is stuck on the rim here, and now we'll apply 1,600 Newtons of braking force. Ah, >> It didn't fly off at all. What a pain. It's such a hassle; I have to pry at it several times to get the cap off. This is the second bottle, Harbin Beer. Can I do it in one go? Can it be quick? What's going on? It didn't even scratch the cap . If I really want to open it, I can.

hold it by hand so the opener doesn't drop too low, and it might work. The third bottle, Budweiser, is the same; it doesn't touch it at all, see? If I force it with my hand, it can actually catch the edge. Damn, what a piece of junk! And after opening just three bottles, the plastic is already worn to nothing. A few more and it’ll probably be completely smooth. The fourth bottle, Wusu; you see, it can't even reach the cap at all. So poorly made, Carlsberg. The Carlsberg bottle won't even fit in. For the Carlsberg, we'll switch to a regular bottle opener; that’s much easier.

item.itunes:title: 洗滑鼠墊要搞這麽複雜？不是洗衣粉就可以嗎？啊 果然... - 洗滑鼠墊妙招
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xkiy4pverYs

值得閱讀的理由

  • 破解網路清潔偏方：實測驗證結合酒精、油、小蘇打粉與洗碗精的繁瑣清潔法是否真有奇效。
  • 直觀效果對比：將滑鼠墊一分為二，真實對照「網路偏方」與「一般洗衣精」的去污能力差距。
  • 避免損壞周邊配件：提醒讀者注意清潔力道與工具選用，避免因過度刷洗導致滑鼠墊纖維破損。

摘要

網路清潔偏方實測

作者展示了邊緣積滿厚重污垢的滑鼠墊，並決定實測網路流傳的清潔密技。作者在滑鼠墊的一側依序噴上酒精、倒少許油、撒上小蘇打粉並加入洗碗精。為了確保受力均勻，作者原本準備了電鑽毛刷進行清潔，卻發現表面過於乾澀難以刷動，在補充大量酒精潤滑後，最終還是改用雙手直接用力刷洗。

洗衣精對照組與清潔結論

對於滑鼠墊的另一半，作者則採用直覺且普遍的洗衣精進行對照清潔，刷洗過程中立刻產生大量泛黃的污垢泡沫。然而在沖洗時，作者察覺滑鼠墊邊緣的紋理產生異樣，疑似被刷子破壞了表面結構。經過一整天風乾後，作者檢視發現兩種方法都能達到去污效果，但強烈刷洗已造成滑鼠墊的纖維起毛磨損；作者最終總結，想要清洗滑鼠墊其實只需洗衣精與普通刷子即可，完全不必費心使用複雜的網路偏方。

================================================

Today we’re covering how to clean a mouse pad. >> As you can see, the edges of my mouse pad are completely gunked up. >> First, spray it with a layer of alcohol , add some oil, and then some dish soap . >> But my first instinct was, shouldn't you just wash a mouse pad with laundry detergent? For the side with the LOL logo, we'll use laundry detergent later ; let's wash the other side first. >> First, spray it with a layer of alcohol . >> Spray the alcohol, >> add some oil, >> sprinkle some baking soda, >> then some dish soap, >> add some dish soap. >> Spread it out evenly, >> to ensure consistent pressure while scrubbing, we've prepared a power drill.

brush. How am I supposed to scrub it while it's so dry? It must be a lack of alcohol; I'll pour the alcohol directly on. It's definitely better now that there's more alcohol. Alright, hand-scrubbing it is, let’s clean the mouse pad. For the other half, we'll use laundry detergent. Regardless of anything else, seeing all those bubbles makes me feel like it should be getting cleaner. >> The lather I scrubbed up turned yellow, and now we'll rinse off the laundry detergent side. Why does it feel like the edge of the mouse pad was torn by.

the brush? The finish looks different. See here in the middle where there's texture? We think it's the brush's fault . The next day it's dry. This side was cleaned using the internet hack. Compared to the truly dirty areas, it actually does get clean, but the point is that using laundry detergent works just as well. >> It's obvious that our scrubbing caused the mouse pad's fibers to fray a bit; laundry detergent and a brush is all you really need.

=============

網路清潔偏方實測

作者展示了邊緣積滿厚重污垢的滑鼠墊，並決定實測網路流傳的清潔密技。作者在滑鼠墊的一側依序噴上酒精、倒少許油、撒上小蘇打粉並加入洗碗精。為了確保受力均勻，作者原本準備了電鑽毛刷進行清潔，卻發現表面過於乾澀難以刷動，在補充大量酒精潤滑後，最終還是改用雙手直接用力刷洗。

洗衣精對照組與清潔結論

對於滑鼠墊的另一半，作者則採用直覺且普遍的洗衣精進行對照清潔，刷洗過程中立刻產生大量泛黃的污垢泡沫。然而在沖洗時，作者察覺滑鼠墊邊緣的紋理產生異樣，疑似被刷子破壞了表面結構。經過一整天風乾後，作者檢視發現兩種方法都能達到去污效果，但強烈刷洗已造成滑鼠墊的纖維起毛磨損；作者最終總結，想要清洗滑鼠墊其實只需洗衣精與普通刷子即可，完全不必費心使用複雜的網路偏方。
